verdict.rationale: Attio is an AI CRM that processes customer data with AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or a data-usage policy for AI models. The image privacy proxy is an unrelated feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
